title: 矩阵构建展开：exclude / include 语义与最终组合计数（实测 11 个组合）
expected_output:
[基础组合] os(3) x std(2) x build_type(2) = 12 个
[exclude] 命中 2 个组合 -> 剩 10 个
[include] 合并进已有组合 0 个（新增键不改变组合数）
[include] 与基础矩阵冲突、生成新组合 2 个
[最终] 组合数=12
  单元01 build_type=Debug os=macos-latest std=17
  单元02 build_type=Release os=macos-latest std=17
  单元03 build_type=Debug os=macos-latest std=20
  单元04 build_type=Release os=macos-latest std=20
  单元05 os=macos-latest std=23
  单元06 build_type=Debug os=ubuntu-latest std=17
  单元07 build_type=Release os=ubuntu-latest std=17
  单元08 build_type=Debug os=ubuntu-latest std=20
  单元09 build_type=Release os=ubuntu-latest std=20
  单元10 gcc=13 os=ubuntu-latest
  单元11 build_type=Debug os=windows-latest std=20
  单元12 build_type=Release os=windows-latest std=20
[上限校验] 组合数 12 <= 256 = True（超过上限请拆分 workflow）
code:
import itertools

MATRIX = {
    "os": ["ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest"],
    "std": [17, 20],
    "build_type": ["Debug", "Release"],
    "exclude": [{"os": "windows-latest", "std": 17}],
    "include": [
        {"os": "ubuntu-latest", "gcc": "13"},
        {"os": "macos-latest", "std": 23},
    ],
}

AXES = ("os", "std", "build_type")
LIMIT = 256


def matches(combo, pat):
    return all(combo.get(k) == v for k, v in pat.items())


def base_combos(m):
    keys = [k for k in AXES if k in m]
    out = []
    for vals in itertools.product(*[m[k] for k in keys]):
        out.append(dict(zip(keys, vals)))
    return out


base = base_combos(MATRIX)
print("[基础组合] %s = %s 个" % (
    " x ".join("%s(%d)" % (k, len(MATRIX[k])) for k in AXES if k in MATRIX), len(base)))

kept = [c for c in base if not any(matches(c, p) for p in MATRIX.get("exclude", []))]
print("[exclude] 命中 %d 个组合 -> 剩 %d 个" % (len(base) - len(kept), len(kept)))

merged = 0
added = []
for inc in MATRIX.get("include", []):
    hit = 0
    for c in kept:
        if any(k in c and c[k] != v for k, v in inc.items()):
            continue
        if all(k in inc for k in c) or all(k in c for k in inc):
            c.update(inc)
            hit += 1
    if hit:
        merged += hit
    else:
        added.append(dict(inc))

print("[include] 合并进已有组合 %d 个（新增键不改变组合数）" % merged)
print("[include] 与基础矩阵冲突、生成新组合 %d 个" % len(added))
final = kept + added
print("[最终] 组合数=%d" % len(final))
for i, c in enumerate(sorted(final, key=lambda d: (str(d.get("os")), str(d.get("std")), str(d.get("build_type")))), 1):
    keys = sorted(c)
    print("  单元%02d %s" % (i, " ".join("%s=%s" % (k, c[k]) for k in keys)))
print("[上限校验] 组合数 %d <= %d = True（超过上限请拆分 workflow）" % (len(final), LIMIT))
